system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"My current phone contract includes Spotify premium & is due to finish next month so I’m looking for a better mobile deal. Once it’s cancelled, can I re-enable my Spotify subscription directly w/ you and, if so, will my playlists remain intact? Thanks."

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! Once you cancel your current subscription, you can re-enable your Spotify Premium directly with us, and your playlists will stay intact! Let us know how it goes! /AI"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Remove '/AI' and add a friendly closing for professionalism."}
